name: Brussels Sprouts, Mashed Potato & Sausage Bowl with Creamy Dijon Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Slice sausages into ½-inch-thick rounds; add to the baking sheet.

Drizzle sprouts and sausages with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sprouts are tender-crisp and sausages are cooked through, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the pot and cook until very tender, 7-10 minutes. Drain potatoes and return to pot.
Meanwhile, combine oil, Dijon, mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add butter, milk, salt, and pepper to potatoes and mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
177 ml whole milk
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide potatoes between bowls, top with Brussels sprouts and sausages; drizzle with creamy Dijon dressing and enjoy!
